context7.description: Current library and framework documentation. Default server.

playwright.description: Default server. Browser automation for Reproduce, Visual and Acceptance phases in every workflow (Microsoft, Apache-2.0, pinned). Remove --headless to watch the browser; --isolated keeps no profile between runs.

phpstorm.description: JetBrains IDE MCP server (symbols, inspections, refactorings, DB). Copy the exact URL from Settings > Tools > MCP Server; JetBrains still serves SSE, which the MCP spec has deprecated in favour of HTTP.

serena.description: Optional. Semantic code navigation via LSP (requires uv).

github.description: Optional. GitHub PRs, issues, and releases over HTTP transport.

obsidian.description: Optional. Obsidian vault via the Local REST API plugin.

sequential-thinking.description: Optional. Structured multi-step reasoning; rarely needed with current models.
